IPT.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/12] To ensure comparability of therapists in the two conditions, we randomly assigned all therapists to either UC or CBT, using a randomized block procedure (see Friedman et al., 1998) to balance the conditions on inclusion of bilingual therapists and on representation of disciplines—psychologists, social workers/MFCCs, and psychiatrists. Note that we adhered strictly to therapist randomization, not excluding any CBT therapists, regardless of their performance in training or competence with CBT during therapy.
